newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet rally stalls with NYMEX, weaker diffs.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet rally stalls with NYMEX, weaker diffs.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell about 2.0 cents a gallon Friday tracking NYMEX, with a week-long rally on differentials finally stalling amid waning refiner buying, traders said.

Gulf Coast 54-grade diffs weakened 0.50 cent, to 1.5 cents over February future. But they remain a full 2.5 cents firmer than a week ago -- when Koch, Texaco, Conoco and other refiners began a concerted buying effort, traders said.
New York Harbor 54-grade, meanwhile, was offered at 5.0 cents over, about 0.30 cent weaker than Thursday diffs, traders said.
((- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
